name: Shadowburn on cooldown, held for the finish
description: Shadowburn whenever ready until the last 20 s (its 15 s cooldown comes back for the finisher); near the end, wait instead of starting a Shadow Bolt when Shadowburn is back within a second. A wait-rule example, not an improvement: on the default setup it loses DPS against the basic rotation (Shadowburn spends Improved Shadow Bolt charges); compare both with scenario:run.
author: rotation-trainer examples

rules.label: Shadowburn (finisher)
rules.comment: A Shadow Bolt started now would land after the end: finish with instant Shadowburn.

rules.label: Hold for Shadowburn
rules.comment: Press nothing: Shadowburn is back within 1 s and a Shadow Bolt would not land in time.
